audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar camp purity, restitution, and suspected-adultery ordeal text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for camp removal, restitution plus fifth, priestly portions, jealousy/suspected-adultery ordeal, written curse, bitter water, and outcome language. Strong anti-misogyny, anti-coercion, and anti-reenactment safeguards required.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Command children of Israel that they send from camp everyone afflicted with scale-disease, everyone with discharge, and everyone unclean by dead soul/life.

familiar.text: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

modern.text: “Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease, anyone who has a bodily discharge, and anyone who is defiled by a dead body.

original.text: צַ֚ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָּל צָר֖וּעַ וְכָל זָ֑ב וְכֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָנָֽפֶשׁ

verses.restored: Male and female you shall send; outside camp you shall send them, so they do not make their camps unclean, in whose midst I dwell.

familiar.text: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

modern.text: You must send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.”

original.text: מִזָּכָ֤ר עַד נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּם וְלֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת מַ֣חֲנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽם

verses.restored: Children of Israel did so and sent them outside camp; as YHWH spoke to Moses, so children of Israel did.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

modern.text: So the Israelites did this, sending such people outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses. Restitution for Trespasses (Luke 19:1–10)

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיְשַׁלְּח֣וּ אוֹתָ֔ם אֶל מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel: When man or woman commits any of sins/misalignments of humanity by acting unfaithfully against YHWH, that soul/life is guilty.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;

modern.text: “Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty

original.text: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִכָּל חַטֹּ֣את הָֽאָדָ֔ם לִמְעֹ֥ל מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָ֑ה וְאָֽשְׁמָ֖ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִֽוא

verses.restored: They shall confess their sin/misalignment that they did; he shall return his guilt in its principal and add fifth upon it, and give it to the one against whom he was guilty.

familiar.text: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

modern.text: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.

original.text: וְהִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת חַטָּאתָם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַחֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַ֕ן לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽוֹ

verses.restored: If the man has no redeemer to whom guilt may be returned, guilt returned to YHWH shall belong to priest, besides ram of atonement/covering by which covering is made for him.

familiar.text: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

modern.text: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement, by which the atonement is made for him.

original.text: וְאִם אֵ֨ין לָאִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְהָשִׁ֤יב הָאָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔יו הָאָשָׁ֛ם הַמּוּשָׁ֥ב לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִלְּבַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר בּ֖וֹ עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: Every contribution from all holy things of children of Israel that they bring near to priest shall belong to him.

familiar.text: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

modern.text: Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest shall belong to him.

original.text: וְכָל תְּרוּמָ֞ה לְכָל קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: Each man's holy things shall be his; whatever a man gives to priest shall belong to him.

familiar.text: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

modern.text: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own, but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.” The Adultery Test

original.text: וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת קֳדָשָׁ֖יו ל֣וֹ יִהְי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥וֹ יִהְיֶֽה

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: Then the LORD said to Moses,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and say to them: Any man whose wife turns aside and acts unfaithfully against him,

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

original.text: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ כִּֽי תִשְׂטֶ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וּמָעֲלָ֥ה ב֖וֹ מָֽעַל

verses.restored: and a man lies with her with emission of seed, and it is hidden from eyes of her husband, and she is concealed though she has become unclean, and there is no witness against her and she was not caught,

familiar.text: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

modern.text: by sleeping with another man, and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act),

original.text: וְשָׁכַ֨ב אִ֣ישׁ אֹתָהּ֮ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע֒ וְנֶעְלַם֙ מֵעֵינֵ֣י אִישָׁ֔הּ וְנִסְתְּרָ֖ה וְהִ֣יא נִטְמָ֑אָה וְעֵד֙ אֵ֣ין בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א נִתְפָּֽשָׂה

verses.restored: and spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous of his wife, and she has become unclean; or spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous of his wife, though she has not become unclean,

familiar.text: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

modern.text: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over her husband and he suspects his wife who has defiled herself—or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects her even though she has not defiled herself—

original.text: וְעָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧יו רֽוּחַ קִנְאָ֛ה וְקִנֵּ֥א אֶת אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְהִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה אוֹ עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֤יו רֽוּחַ קִנְאָה֙ וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהִ֖יא לֹ֥א נִטְמָֽאָה

verses.restored: then the man shall bring his wife to priest and bring her offering for her, one-tenth ephah of barley flour; he shall pour no oil on it and put no frankincense on it, for it is grain offering of jealousy, grain offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

familiar.text: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

modern.text: then he is to bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity.

original.text: וְהֵבִ֨יא הָאִ֣ישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ֮ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת קָרְבָּנָהּ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ עֲשִׂירִ֥ת הָאֵיפָ֖ה קֶ֣מַח שְׂעֹרִ֑ים לֹֽא יִצֹ֨ק עָלָ֜יו שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹֽא יִתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּֽי מִנְחַ֤ת קְנָאֹת֙ ה֔וּא מִנְחַ֥ת זִכָּר֖וֹן מַזְכֶּ֥רֶת עָוֺֽן

verses.restored: Priest shall bring her near and stand her before YHWH.

familiar.text: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:

modern.text: The priest is to bring the wife forward and have her stand before the LORD.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהֶֽעֱמִדָ֖הּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Priest shall take holy water in earthen vessel, and from dust on floor of dwelling-place priest shall take and put into water.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

modern.text: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar and put some of the dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.

original.text: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מַ֥יִם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים בִּכְלִי חָ֑רֶשׂ וּמִן הֶֽעָפָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנָתַ֥ן אֶל הַמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: Priest shall stand woman before YHWH, loosen hair of woman's head, and put grain offering of remembrance in her palms—it is grain offering of jealousy—and in priest's hand shall be bitter water bringing curse.

familiar.text: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

modern.text: After the priest has the woman stand before the LORD, he is to let down her hair and place in her hands the grain offering of memorial, which is the grain offering for jealousy. The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse.

original.text: וְהֶעֱמִ֨יד הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת הָאִשָּׁה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וּפָרַע֙ אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנָתַ֣ן עַל כַּפֶּ֗יהָ אֵ֚ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַזִּכָּר֔וֹן מִנְחַ֥ת קְנָאֹ֖ת הִ֑וא וּבְיַ֤ד הַכֹּהֵן֙ יִהְי֔וּ מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרֲרִֽים

verses.restored: Priest shall make her swear and say to woman: If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside into uncleanness under your husband, be free from this bitter water bringing curse.

familiar.text: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

modern.text: And he is to put the woman under oath and say to her, ‘If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse.

original.text: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אֹתָ֜הּ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאָמַ֤ר אֶל הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אִם לֹ֨א שָׁכַ֥ב אִישׁ֙ אֹתָ֔ךְ וְאִם לֹ֥א שָׂטִ֛ית טֻמְאָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת אִישֵׁ֑ךְ הִנָּקִ֕י מִמֵּ֛י הַמָּרִ֥ים הַֽמְאָרֲרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה

verses.restored: But if you have turned aside under your husband and become unclean, and a man besides your husband has given his emission in you—

familiar.text: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

modern.text: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband’—

original.text: וְאַ֗תְּ כִּ֥י שָׂטִ֛ית תַּ֥חַת אִישֵׁ֖ךְ וְכִ֣י נִטְמֵ֑את וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אִ֥ישׁ בָּךְ֙ אֶת שְׁכָבְתּ֔וֹ מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֖י אִישֵֽׁךְ

verses.restored: then priest shall make woman swear with oath of curse, and priest shall say to woman: May YHWH make you for curse and oath among your people, when YHWH makes your thigh fall and your belly swell.

familiar.text: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

modern.text: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse—‘then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell.

original.text: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת הָֽאִשָּׁה֮ בִּשְׁבֻעַ֣ת הָאָלָה֒ וְאָמַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ךְ לְאָלָ֥ה וְלִשְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑ךְ בְּתֵ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אֶת יְרֵכֵךְ֙ נֹפֶ֔לֶת וְאֶת בִּטְנֵ֖ךְ צָבָֽה

verses.restored: This water bringing curse shall enter your inward parts, to make belly swell and thigh fall. And woman shall say, Amen, amen.

familiar.text: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

modern.text: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.’ Then the woman is to say, ‘Amen, Amen.’

original.text: וּ֠בָאוּ הַמַּ֨יִם הַמְאָרְרִ֤ים הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּֽמֵעַ֔יִךְ לַצְבּ֥וֹת בֶּ֖טֶן וְלַנְפִּ֣ל יָרֵ֑ךְ וְאָמְרָ֥ה הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אָמֵ֥ן אָמֵֽן

verses.restored: Priest shall write these curses in scroll and wipe them into bitter water.

familiar.text: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

modern.text: And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water.

original.text: וְ֠כָתַב אֶת הָאָלֹ֥ת הָאֵ֛לֶּה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּסֵּ֑פֶר וּמָחָ֖ה אֶל מֵ֥י הַמָּרִֽים

verses.restored: He shall make woman drink bitter water bringing curse, and water bringing curse shall enter her for bitterness.

familiar.text: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

modern.text: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and it will enter her and cause her bitter suffering.

original.text: וְהִשְׁקָה֙ אֶת הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרֲרִ֑ים וּבָ֥אוּ בָ֛הּ הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽמְאָרֲרִ֖ים לְמָרִֽים

verses.restored: Priest shall take grain offering of jealousy from woman's hand, wave grain offering before YHWH, and bring it near altar.

familiar.text: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:

modern.text: The priest shall take from her hand the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

original.text: וְלָקַ֤ח הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִיַּ֣ד הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת וְהֵנִ֤יף אֶת הַמִּנְחָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ

verses.restored: Priest shall take handful from grain offering as memorial portion and turn it into smoke on altar; afterward he shall make woman drink water.

familiar.text: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

modern.text: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.

original.text: וְקָמַ֨ץ הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִן הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֶת אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔הּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְאַחַ֛ר יַשְׁקֶ֥ה אֶת הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת הַמָּֽיִם

verses.restored: When he has made her drink water, if she has become unclean and acted unfaithfully against her husband, water bringing curse shall enter her for bitterness; her belly shall swell and her thigh shall fall, and woman shall become a curse among her people.

familiar.text: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

modern.text: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.

original.text: וְהִשְׁקָ֣הּ אֶת הַמַּ֗יִם וְהָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם נִטְמְאָה֮ וַתִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּאִישָׁהּ֒ וּבָ֨אוּ בָ֜הּ הַמַּ֤יִם הַמְאָֽרֲרִים֙ לְמָרִ֔ים וְצָבְתָ֣ה בִטְנָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה יְרֵכָ֑הּ וְהָיְתָ֧ה הָאִשָּׁ֛ה לְאָלָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ

verses.restored: But if woman has not become unclean and is clean, then she shall be free and shall conceive seed.

familiar.text: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

modern.text: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.

original.text: וְאִם לֹ֤א נִטְמְאָה֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וּטְהֹרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְנִקְּתָ֖ה וְנִזְרְעָ֥ה זָֽרַע

verses.restored: This is Torah/instruction of jealousies, when a wife turns aside under her husband and becomes unclean,

familiar.text: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

modern.text: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority,

original.text: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַקְּנָאֹ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׂטֶ֥ה אִשָּׁ֛ה תַּ֥חַת אִישָׁ֖הּ וְנִטְמָֽאָה

verses.restored: or when spirit of jealousy passes over a man and he is jealous of his wife; he shall stand woman before YHWH, and priest shall do to her all this Torah/instruction.

familiar.text: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

modern.text: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.

original.text: א֣וֹ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תַּעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֛יו ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֶת הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְעָ֤שָׂה לָהּ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל הַתּוֹרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת

verses.restored: The man shall be free from iniquity, but that woman shall bear her iniquity.

familiar.text: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

modern.text: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.”

original.text: וְנִקָּ֥ה הָאִ֖ישׁ מֵעָוֺ֑ן וְהָאִשָּׁ֣ה הַהִ֔וא תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת עֲוֺנָֽהּ

translation_notes: Verses 2-4 are camp-boundary instructions in a sanctuary-centered wilderness setting; they must not justify abandoning sick or disabled people.
Restitution in verses 5-10 applies to man or woman and requires confession, principal return, and added fifth.

The suspected-adultery ordeal is an ancient patriarchal jealousy procedure centered on the wife, with no parallel ordeal for a husband. Preserve this asymmetry for critique rather than smoothing it away.
The ritual may function as a controlled priestly procedure that prevents immediate private retaliation, but it remains coercive and must never be reenacted.
Outcome language involving belly/thigh is textually and medically uncertain and requires deep lexical audit.
Verse 31's asymmetry must not be used to excuse controlling, jealous, or abusive husbands.
safety_note: Do not reenact, imitate, prescribe, or spiritually replicate the Numbers 5 ordeal. Do not use it to coerce women, accuse partners without evidence, excuse jealousy, shame infertility, blame survivors, or authorize abuse. Preserve it as a difficult ancient patriarchal legal-ritual text under explicit ethical critique.
